plainSummary: The plan lets users rerun saved checks without allowing browser-supplied commands or confusing accepted jobs with passing tests.
summary: Reviewed W010 written spec, metadata, security-sensitive local bridge boundary and tool-built related pack (SL001/002/003/017/018/022/023 among related claims). Fixed configured repository cwd, saved binding identity plus displayed source/check digests, shared runner across batch/CLI/MCP/local UI, same-origin loopback token bridge, strict bounded inputs, durable start identity, one execution guard, bounded integrity-checked output and passive polling preserve existing contracts. Clarification added: trusted repository shell code is not sandboxed; guard ownership persists until confirmed owned-child termination; ambiguous crash/orphan guards cannot be stolen by elapsed time or PID reuse. Required tests include real allowed control and denial with no child, stale inputs, retry/crash ambiguity, concurrent batch paths, bounded output and artifact tamper. No blocking spec gaps remain.
residualRisks: Saved repository commands run with host privileges; the local bridge is an intent boundary, not a sandbox for malicious repository code.
Uncertain worker termination intentionally can leave execution unavailable until explicit safe recovery; no automatic relaunch is authorized.
Related pack provides a caution-only worktree notice, not verified sibling checkout findings.
